argv: Capture from Chronicle and the journal (HC1-HC15, decision 0112; JN1-JN24, decision 0155)
three square tiles to a row
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone SE (320 pt) and a Pro Max (430 pt), look at the quick-action row under a photo entry, a note entry and the entry just kept (with Join); tap 2 pt left of "Reaction"; then set the largest Dynamic Type (and Android's largest font scale) and look again. **Expect:** the row starts at the entry's leading edge, "Reaction" in line with the entry's words, slots of one width with any empty slot as room at the end; the tap at the left opens the reactions (the slot reaches 10 pt past its parent); at the largest text the captions grow only to 1.3x and stay whole, five fitting at 320 pt. (fix quick-actions-leading, audit 1)
